posts.caption:
Some words stick with you.

Over the years, I’ve collected a few quotes that genuinely changed the way I think, work, and move through life. 💭

These are a few I still come back to, because sometimes the right words at the right time can change everything.

Swipe through, and tell me: which one do you need to hear right now? 👇

Sometimes the voice telling you to quit is wisdom. Sometimes it’s fear, doubt, exhaustion, or the discomfort of doing something that actually matters. 💭

The trick is learning to tell the difference.

Before you give up, pause. Get curious. Ask yourself what’s really going on—and what you actually want.

What's something you quit that turned out to be a blessing? Tell me in the comments. 👇

Throwing it back to my conversation with Lewis Howes. 

There’s a big difference between easy money and making money easy. 💰

In my conversation with Lewis Howes, we talked about the temptation to chase the shortcut—the next big opportunity, the get-rich-quick promise, the thing that looks like easy money.

But “easy money” can come with a very expensive lesson.

Making money easy is different. It’s about building the skills, experience, and systems that make creating wealth more sustainable over time.

Want to hear the full conversation with Lewis? Comment MONEY and I’ll send you the episode. 👇

Quick question: How many sales might you have lost when the right person landed on your website, opened your email, or saw your post…
…but your words didn’t click? 😬

Great copy isn’t about sounding clever, polished, or “professional.”
It’s about knowing how to write words that connect, persuade, and sound unmistakably like YOU.

Because in a noisy world,  writing that connects is a SUPER POWER.
And the good news? It’s a skill you can learn. 🙌

I created a FREE 7-Day Writing Class to help you do exactly that.
Comment WRITE and I’ll send it your way. 💌

And P.S. — if you’re ready to go much deeper, mark your calendar. 👀
We’ve got a VERY special Copy Cure offer coming October 12.
More soon. ✍️💖

Rewind to one of my favorite conversations. 💭

What if the thing you’ve been taught to see as a weakness is actually pointing you toward your greatest strength? 

In my conversation with Bryce Dallas Howard, we talked about how her learning disability shaped the way she sees herself, her strengths, and the way she works.

Sometimes the thing that makes you feel different can become the very thing that helps you find your path. ✨

Want to hear the full conversation with Bryce? Comment GIFT and I’ll send you the episode. 👇

Some weeks are full of wins.
Others are just about making it to the other side.

Whatever this week held for you, you made it through. And that counts. 🤍

Take a breath. Give yourself some credit. Now enjoy your weekend.

Happy October! 🍂🎃
There’s something about this time of year I just love. The summer travels wind down, the pace gets a little slower, and sweater weather gives me an excuse to cozy up and actually sit still for a minute. 😂

So I made myself an October bingo card with a few of my favorite fall things! 🎃👻🍁

What’s in store for you this October? 🍂

You keep saying “someday.”

Someday when you have more time.
Someday when the timing is right.
Someday when everything is figured out.

But here’s the thing: your life is happening today. ❤️

Don’t wait so long to start living the life you want that you forget to enjoy the one you have.

What’s one thing you’re done putting off until “someday”? 👇

Sometimes you don’t need more answers. You need to ask yourself better questions. 🧠✨

Take a few minutes today to slow down, get quiet, and check in with yourself.

You might be surprised by what comes up when you stop looking outside yourself for the answer.

Which question made you stop and think? 👇

Your morning routine might be sabotaging your productivity before your day even starts. 📱🧠

The second you open your phone, you’re letting other people’s priorities, notifications, and noise into your brain before you’ve had a chance to focus on your own.

Try this instead: give yourself a little time in the morning before you reach for your phone.

Protect your attention. Protect your energy. And start your day on your terms. ✨

Could you go phone-free for the first 30 minutes of your day? 👇

Outside of work? 😂

I like to dance, laugh, play, explore, and enjoy the heck out of this wild little life. 💃✨

Because building a meaningful business matters to me, but so does having a life I actually love living.

Reminder: You’re allowed to be more than what you do for work. ❤️

What’s your favorite thing to do when you’re not working? 👇
